global_rules: Read docs/realtime/rebuild-spec.md fully before starting; it is the source of truth. Requirement IDs (RQ-*) and sections (§n) refer to it.
Strict file ownership: edit only files in your task's `files` list; create new files only under directories listed with `/**`.

Frozen contracts owned by the foundation and NOT editable by parallel tasks: src/shared/**, src/game/types.ts, src/session/types.ts, src/app/room/[id]/session/types.ts. If a change is needed, add a local extension type in your own files and note it for integration.
src/game, src/session, src/shared: relative runtime imports only (type-only `@/` imports allowed); no Node/DOM/Workers APIs; no Math.random or Date.now (inject Rng and time).
Leave `npm test` green for your files; `tsc` clean except explicitly named cross-task seams.
Commit messages in English. Do NOT deploy anything. Do not commit secrets.

foundation.title: Foundation: tooling, frozen contracts, shared helpers, stubs
foundation.instructions:
1) package.json: add devDependencies wrangler, @cloudflare/workers-types, concurrently, fast-check, @playwright/test (exact versions verified via `npm view`, at least 2 weeks old); remove parcel-bundler. Scripts: `dev` = `concurrently -k -n web,rt "next dev" "npm:dev:server"`, `dev:web` = `next dev`, `dev:server` = `WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --local --persist-to .wrangler/state`, `typecheck` = `tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p worker`, `test:integration` = `INTEGRATION=1 vitest run --project integration`, `test:e2e` = `playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts`, `deploy:server` = `wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --env production`, `biome:ci` = `biome ci src worker e2e`. Keep dev:pk, deploy, partykit and partysocket until integration. Run `npm install` to update the lockfile.
2) tsconfig.json: exclude `worker`, `e2e`, `dist-worker`. worker/tsconfig.json: strict, types [@cloudflare/workers-types], lib esnext, moduleResolution bundler, include worker/src/**, worker/test/**, ../src/shared/**, ../src/game/**, ../src/session/**; paths `@/*` -> `../src/*`. worker/wrangler.jsonc: name prime-daifugo-rt, main src/index.ts, compatibility_date 2026-11-01, durable_objects bindings ROOM->RoomDO, LOBBY->LobbyDO, migrations [{tag:'v1', new_sqlite_classes:['RoomDO','LobbyDO']}], vars with dev ALLOWED_ORIGINS and default GRACE_PLAYING_MS=120000, GRACE_IDLE_MS=60000, AWAY_TURN_CAP_MS=20000, ROOM_TTL_IDLE_MS=600000, ROOM_TTL_ACTIVE_MS=1800000, plus an env.production block with placeholder origins. worker/src/index.ts stub: exports default fetch returning 501 and empty RoomDO/LobbyDO classes extending DurableObject so `wrangler dev` starts.
3) vitest.config.ts: unit project include `src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}` and `worker/test/*.test.ts`; exclude `worker/test/integration/**`; add `integration` project (environment node, include worker/test/integration/**, only when INTEGRATION=1); coverage thresholds per spec §12.3 (src/game/** 95/90, src/session/** 90/80 excluding src/session/sim/**, worker/src/** 85/75 excluding room-do.ts, lobby-do.ts, index.ts, src/app/room/*/session/** 85/75); keep existing thresholds; remove nothing else yet (src/partykit exclusion is removed in integration).
4) biome.jsonc: include worker and e2e; restrict globals setTimeout/setInterval in worker/src/** (override with noRestrictedGlobals).
5) .gitignore: add .wrangler/, worker/.dev.vars, test-results/, playwright-report/, dist-worker/. .env.development: add NEXT_PUBLIC_REALTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787 (keep the PartyKit var until integration).
6) src/constants/env.ts: export REALTIME_URL (NEXT_PUBLIC_REALTIME_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8787 only when NODE_ENV !== 'production'; in production an unset value yields null and callers surface connection 'error'), wsUrl(path) and httpUrl(path) helpers. Keep PARTYKIT_* exports. next.config.mjs: throw when VERCEL_ENV==='production' and NEXT_PUBLIC_REALTIME_URL is unset or contains localhost/127.0.0.1.
7) Frozen contracts, typed exactly as spec §4.1 (src/session/types.ts: RoomState, Member, RoomConfig with defaults, SessionInput = connect|disconnect|command|tick|reconcile, ReducerDeps {now, rng, engine, config}, ReducerResult {state, events: {seq, e}[], directives (welcome{pid,mode,fromSeq}, ack{pid,connNo,id,result}, bye{pid,connNo,reason,code}, close), wakeAt, lobbyCount}), §6 (src/shared/protocol.ts: zod schemas + types for Hello, CmdFrame, Cmd, Welcome, Evt, Ack, Bye, RoomEvent, RejectReason, SubmitResultCode, View, LobbyStats, CLOSE codes, parseClientFrame, parseServerFrame), §7.1 (src/game/types.ts), §9.1 (src/app/room/[id]/session/types.ts) and §9.3 (src/shared/client-state.ts). PrimeDaifugoSetupData/FactCardId stay imported from src/interface/common.ts (type-only).
8) src/shared/rule-options.ts: ALLOWED_RULES, DEFAULT_RULE (from ../constants/config GAME_CONFIG, relative import), parseRulePatch. src/shared/name.ts: isValidName (trim, 3-10 UTF-16 units, matching current middleware), normalizeName. src/shared/ids.ts: ROOM_ID_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/, SID_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/, SID_COOKIE='pd_sid', generateSid() via globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues, PV=1. src/shared/rng.ts: Rng interface re-export, mulberry32(seed), cryptoRng(), shuffle(arr, rng) (Fisher-Yates, returns new array).
9) src/lib/session-id.ts (client only): getOrCreateSid(): read cookie pd_sid (js-cookie), validate, mirror to localStorage, restore cookie from localStorage, else generate and set cookie (365 days, SameSite=Lax, Secure on https); all storage in try/catch.
10) src/test-utils.tsx: ADD makeClientGameState, makeClientCtx, makeClientBundle, makeView, makeMember, frames.{welcome,evt,ack,bye} builders typed against the new contracts; keep all existing exports untouched.
11) Stubs: src/game/engine.ts exports `engine: GameEngine` whose methods throw Error('not implemented'); src/session/reducer.ts exports `roomReduce` and `initialRoomState` throwing/ minimal; src/session/view.ts exports `viewFor` throwing; use-room-session.ts exports a hook returning a static disconnected RoomSession.
12) Spike: run `npm run dev:server` with networking disabled; record outcome, startup time and any needed env flags in docs/realtime/spike-notes.md.
Acceptance: `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` pass; `npm run dev:server` starts and GET /healthz-equivalent stub responds; tests: protocol schemas accept valid fixtures and reject malformed ones (oversize arrays, bad card ids, unknown types); parseRulePatch rejects timeLimit 30 / initNumCards 5 / maxSubmitNumCards 10; isValidName table tests incl. trimming; mulberry32 determinism; session-id cookie/localStorage restore paths.

tasks.title: Rules engine (pure, BigInt, deterministic) with ported and new tests
tasks.instructions:
Implement spec §7 against the frozen GameEngine contract in src/game/types.ts. cards.ts: full deck, halfEvenNumbers filter (RQ-R5), cardValue. numbers.ts: concatValue -> bigint, bitLength, isPrime(bigint) = small-prime trial division + deterministic Miller-Rabin bases 2..41 below 3.317e24 + strong Lucas (BPSW) above; document BPSW status in the header. factor.ts: parseFact with the syntax of RQ-R16 (one ^ level only, no operand equal to 1, <=64 tokens), checkFact with guarded evaluation and INCORRECT_ANSWER precedence. engine.ts: setup (2-4 seats, deck check initNumCards*seats, playOrder as given, currentPlayer=playOrder[0], turn=0), applyMove implementing validation order RQ-R12 (multiset distinctness across submit+factor), judging RQ-R13, success RQ-R14, penalties RQ-R15 (draw from array end), flow RQ-R11, 57 cut RQ-R17 (success only, keeps turn but increments turn), end RQ-R18 (winner set before flow resets deckTopPlayer), bad-status after end RQ-R19, draw rules RQ-R9 (deck-empty, already-drawn); timeoutPass == pass for currentPlayer; forfeit per spec §3.6 (hand to deck + shuffle, leave playOrder, immediate flow if deckTopPlayer, advance turn if current, last-standing end). Never mutate input (structuredClone). Use injected Rng for every shuffle. Port every case from src/partykit/room/logic/game-rule/{game-rule,game-party}.test.ts into engine.ported.test.ts and the factor cases of src/utils/play-card.test.ts into factor.ported.test.ts; mark intentional differences with `// CHANGED: <reason>` (spec §7.4). Add every new test listed in spec §7.4 and fast-check property tests (seeded) for conservation, currentPlayer in playOrder, rejected-move immutability, winner iff empty hand, monotonic turn. src/utils/play-card.ts: keep every exported name and signature used by the UI (getCardNumber, concatCardNumbers, concatFactCardIds, isValidFactCardIds, isValidFactCardIdsStrict, evalFactCardIds, extractCardIdsFromFactCardIds, compareCard); make isValidFactCardIds/isValidFactCardIdsStrict delegate to src/game/factor.ts so client pre-validation equals the server; evalFactCardIds/concatCardNumbers stay number-returning display helpers (document). Update play-card.test.ts accordingly (tower cases now invalid; keep display eval tests).
Acceptance: coverage src/game/** >= 95 lines / 90 branches; all ported pinned cases present (count printed in a comment block at the top of each ported file); property tests 200 runs pass; play-card exports unchanged (tsc clean for UI importers); no Math.random/Date.now in src/game.

tasks.title: Session reducer, per-viewer view, deterministic simulator
tasks.instructions:
Implement roomReduce(state, input, deps) and initialRoomState(roomId, epoch, config) per spec §3, §4.1, §5, §6 using only the injected GameEngine (deps.engine), deps.now, deps.rng. Inputs: connect (new/existing member, supersede previous connNo with bye superseded 4001, room-full 4002, bad-name 4003, welcome mode current/replay/snapshot using epoch, lastSeq, ringFloor), disconnect (ignore stale connNo; set graceUntil by status; cap current player's deadline to now+AWAY_TURN_CAP_MS if it is their turn), command (ready/unready in waiting|waitingNextRound incl. observers; set-rule via parseRulePatch; start with expectedVersion, >=2 ready+connected, first 4 by readyAt seated, seat order shuffled with rng, setup computed before status change, roles recomputed; draw/pass/submit with turn guard -> 'stale', non-current -> 'not-your-turn', engine rejects mapped; leave = forfeit if seated in game + remove member + bye left 4000), tick (timeout pass, grace expiry -> forfeit/remove, gc), reconcile (members marked connected without live socket -> disconnected with fresh grace; if playing, deadline = max(deadline, now+10s)). Deadline policy spec §5 (set on every core.turn change and at start; null outside playing). Each emitted event increments version; winning submit emits submitted then game-ended. Rejected commands produce only an ack directive and leave state reference-equal. Maintain ringFloor (RING_SIZE 64), gcAt (10 min waiting / 30 min otherwise when no member connected; cleared on connect), lobbyCount = connected members. view.ts: viewFor(state, pid) per spec §6.3 (own hand only, handCount for others, deckCount, members sorted by joinedAt, winner {id,name}). testing/fake-engine.ts: a small deterministic GameEngine implementation (counter game honoring the contract: turns, draws, deck conservation, end condition, forfeit) used by reducer tests. Simulator per spec §12.1: SimClock (virtual priority queue, at-least-once alarms with seeded duplicates), SimHost (in-memory persist + ring + reconcile + crashRestart, mirrors DO host semantics), SimNetwork (delay, close, half-open until sweep, duplicate hello, second tab, reload with lastSeq, offline duration), SimClient (minimal model: applies welcome/evt by seq/epoch rules; integration swaps in real clientReduce via an injectable interface), invariants.ts (spec §3.8 plus §12.1 list). Write every scripted scenario of spec §12.1 as a named test, using the fake engine now; structure so the engine is injectable (integration adds a real-engine fuzz). Fuzz: 200 seeds x 300 steps default, SIM_RUNS and SIM_SEED env overrides, print seed on failure.
Acceptance: all scenarios and fuzz pass; coverage src/session/** (excluding sim/**) >= 90/80; tests prove: reload keeps seat+hand; blip within grace replays (no snapshot) when lastSeq in ring; away current player times out at <=20s; grace expiry forfeits and conserves cards; duplicate tab supersedes; double start deals once (stale); late joiner sees stored rule; crashRestart keeps deadline >= now+10s; no frame leaks other hands; no deadline outside playing.

tasks.title: Cloudflare Worker: pure host, RoomDO, LobbyDO, router, wrangler config
tasks.instructions:
Implement spec §2.1, §3.3-3.4, §4.2-4.4, §5 host side, §6 framing, §8. room-host.ts (pure, no cloudflare imports): class RoomHost({storage: HostStorage, sockets: HostSocketRegistry, clock: Clock, reducer, engine, config, lobby: LobbyPort}) with onLoad(liveSockets) -> runs reconcile, onHello(socket, frame) (validate pv in {PV,PV-1} else bye upgrade-required 4005, validate sid format, pid = base64url(sha256('pd:'+sid)).slice(0,16) via crypto.ts, then call reducer synchronously after the await), onFrame (zod parse, 8KB cap, rate limit 20/5s -> ack rate-limited, protocol violations -> bye 4004, hello timeout 10s tracked via alarm/sweep not setTimeout), onClose, onAlarm (tick + sweep: close sockets whose auto-response timestamp is older than 75s and feed disconnect; re-report lobby every 5 min while count>0). Persist order per accepted input: upsert room_state, insert events + trim ring, set/delete alarm when wakeAt changes, THEN send frames (rendered per viewer with viewFor; replay reads ring rows seq>lastSeq). storage.ts: HostStorage interface + SqlStorage (ctx.storage.sql + setAlarm) + MemoryStorage for tests. sockets.ts: HostSocket {send, close, attachment, pid, connNo, lastPongAt}. room-do.ts / lobby-do.ts: thin DurableObject classes (blockConcurrencyWhile load, acceptWebSocket(ws,[pid]) with serializeAttachment, setWebSocketAutoResponse ping/pong, webSocketMessage/Close/Error, alarm, RPC info() and report()/release()/allocate()) delegating to the pure cores; NO setTimeout/setInterval. lobby-core.ts: allocate smallest free prime < 1e6 with 10 min reservation, report/release, stale cutoff 12 min, stats {lobby, room}, debounced broadcast through alarm (<=1/s). index.ts: router per spec §8.1 (ROOM_ID_RE, Origin allow-list from ALLOWED_ORIGINS, CORS for HTTP, upgrades without allowed Origin -> 403, /healthz, locationHint 'apac'). config.ts parses vars into RoomConfig. Tests (L2h, node env, unit project): MemoryStorage + fake sockets + fake clock + a fake reducer where useful, and the real reducer/engine once available behind describe.skipIf(stub) guards; must cover persist-before-send ordering (storage write recorded before any socket.send), ring replay rendering per viewer, supersede closes old socket with 4001, reconcile on load, wakeAt -> setAlarm changes only when different, sweep closes stale sockets, lobby allocation uniqueness under 50 sequential calls, stale row drop, report count 0 deletes unreserved, router 404 on bad id, 403 on bad Origin, CORS headers. Integration (opt-in INTEGRATION=1): start-worker.ts uses wrangler unstable_startWorker with vars GRACE_PLAYING_MS=1500, GRACE_IDLE_MS=1500, short timeLimit via rule 15 and AWAY_TURN_CAP_MS=1000; tests with Node 22 global WebSocket: hello->welcome snapshot, same sid reconnect -> same selfId and hand, forced close + reconnect within grace -> replay, grace expiry -> member removed/forfeit, dispose + restart on same persist dir -> state preserved and deadline >= now+10s, alarm-driven timeout pass event, second socket same sid -> first gets 4001, POST /rooms returns distinct primes. Keep total integration runtime under ~20s.
Seams: compiles against T1/T2 stubs until they land; integration task flips skip guards.
Acceptance: `npm run typecheck` clean for worker; `npx wrangler deploy --dry-run -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --outdir dist-worker` bundles; L2h coverage of worker/src (excluding DO bindings and index) >= 85/75; `npm run dev:server` serves /healthz, POST /rooms and a room WS locally offline.

tasks.title: Client session layer: transport, client reducer, adapter, server clock, useRoomSession
tasks.instructions:
Implement spec §9.1-9.3 and §3.4 client side, §6.4 client rules. transport.ts: RoomTransport interface. ws-transport.ts: reconnecting WebSocket (backoff 0.5,1,2,4,8,10s cap with +/-30% jitter; no reconnect after close codes 4000-4006 or after a bye frame; ping text every 20s; force reconnect if no frame for 45s; immediate reconnect on visibilitychange->visible, online, pageshow(persisted) when not OPEN or quiet >25s; injectable timers/WebSocket ctor for tests). client-reducer.ts: pure clientReduce(state, frame) -> {state, transitions[], acks[]} applying welcome (snapshot/replay/current), evt (seq===last+1 animate; <= ignore; gap -> snapshot transition), epoch change -> snapshot, ack resolution, bye -> closeReason. adapter.ts: viewToBundle(view, selfId) -> ClientGameStateBundle (players[self].hand = view.game.hand, others hand [] with handCount; deckCount; ctx {currentPlayer, playOrder, turn, deadline}; winner id), viewToPresence(view) -> SessionPresence[] (status from ready), eventToSystemMessage per spec §9.2 mapping table (presence/ready/forfeited/member-left -> no SystemMessage; forfeited -> snapshot-type transition). server-clock.ts: EMA offset from serverNow, interval driving the existing TurnClock store (find it via game-board/TurnTimer imports) only while deadline != null; injectable now/interval. use-room-session.ts: hook implementing RoomSession exactly; gets sid via src/lib/session-id.ts and name from cookie `name`; builds URL with wsUrl(`/rooms/${id}/ws`); sends hello with lastSeq/epoch kept in memory (and sessionStorage per room for reload replay, try/catch); actions send cmd frames with generated ids, include turn/expectedVersion from latest state, resolve on ack (10s timeout -> {ok:false, reason:'timeout'}, closed socket -> 'disconnected'); connection mapping: connecting (incl. reconnecting, board kept), open, closed (terminal bye; closeReason set), error (REALTIME_URL null or repeated failures before first welcome), waiting-sync (open but no welcome yet); bad-name -> location.assign('/login?callback='+path); upgrade-required -> reload once guarded by sessionStorage; reconnect() resets terminal state and reconnects; leave() sends leave, awaits ack/bye, then closes. src/test-mocks/room-transport.ts: fake with control.last().__open(), __emit(frameObj), __close(code), __error(), sent(), lastCmd(), and a factory the hook accepts via an optional `transportFactory` param/context.
Acceptance: tests cover every RoomEvent mapping, seq gap/duplicate/epoch rules, replay animates while snapshot does not, ack timeout and disconnect, terminal codes do not reconnect, backoff jitter bounds, visibility/online triggers, liveness reconnect, deadline->seconds with skew; coverage src/app/room/*/session/** >= 85/75; no imports from src/partykit or partysocket.

tasks.title: Board view-model retype (handCount/deckCount/winner) and presentational additions
tasks.instructions:
Re-point all type imports in board modules from @/partykit/* and @/interface/{server-to-client,client-to-server} to @/shared/client-state and @/shared/protocol (keep @/interface/common for FactCardId/SetupData). Adopt client R2 option (a): seat-model.ts reads players[id].handCount; board-state.ts handOf/handSize use handCount, winnerIdOf prefers gameState.winner then empty-hand fallback, connectionStateOf may remain but is no longer required by the container; flight-plan.ts arrivedCards uses id diff for self and handCount delta for others (Math.max(1, delta) unchanged semantics), deal plan from handCount; classify-transition.ts penalty = next.handCount - prev.handCount and accepts the T.GameState alias = ClientGameStateBundle; types.ts SubmitResultCode derived from @/shared/protocol SubmitResultCode (INVALID_FACT kept). Presentational additions per spec §9.4: Seat optional `connected?: boolean` (dashed outline + aria suffix 「（再接続中）」 when false; default unchanged), ConnectionOverlay optional `reason?: CloseReason` (superseded copy 「別のタブで開かれています」 + button 「このタブで再開」 calling onReconnect; room-gone copy 「この部屋は閉じられました」 with link to /), GameSetDialog optional `selfReady?`, `isObserver?`, `onToggleReady?` (toggle labelled 「次のラウンドに参加」 for observers, 「準備OK」/「取消」 otherwise). Do not change any existing prop or default rendering. Update/extend tests and stories for each change. Retype src/app/labo/gallery fixtures/scenes to the new shapes (handCount etc.), add gallery scenes `reconnecting-seat` and `superseded`; keep existing scene names working for scripts/screens.mjs.
Acceptance: all board tests and gallery fixture tests pass; coverage thresholds for src/app/room/*/_ui/board/** unchanged (85/75); no imports from src/partykit or @/interface/server-to-client in owned files; `npm run screens` renders all existing scenes with no console errors (run against next dev).

tasks.title: Room page wiring: game-board container on useRoomSession, leave button, next-round ready
tasks.instructions:
Replace the data wiring of game-board.tsx (about L56-226 and every ws.* read) with `useRoomSession(id)` per spec §9.2 table; keep the JSX tree, director (direct()), toasts/notices, useMyField and tray logic. selfId replaces ws.id; actions replace ClientMessenger; session.connection and session.closeReason feed ConnectionOverlay (pass reason prop); subscribe(t => msg.action==='snapshot' ? set state only : direct(t.prev, t.next, t.msg)); observer guard = selfId not in game.ctx.playOrder (role from presence); hand from game.gameState.players[selfId].hand; deck count from deckCount; delete the client auto-pass; log 「時間切れです」 (and red toast if it was me) on t.event passed reason timeout; winner name from game-ended event; submit rejections (ack ok:false) go to the existing setTray({error, shakeKey+1}) + red toast path with a reason->Japanese message map ('not-your-turn','stale','invalid-move','invalid-fact','deck-empty','already-drawn','bad-status'); start uses actions.startGame() (no client rule); rule changes via actions.changeRule(patch) and the displayed rule is session.rule (server-stored). Pass `connected` to seats via presence (T5 prop), GameSetDialog ready-toggle props (T5) wired to setReady/unsetReady, RoomHeader new optional `onLeave` prop rendering 「退出」 with a Mantine confirm modal -> actions.leave() then router.push('/'). waiting-room.tsx: retype presence to SessionPresence (keep props and visuals; show ◌ for disconnected members). notification-message.tsx: retype. hooks.ts: delete useMessageHandler, keep useMyField and its tests; drop the dispatch tests in hooks.test.ts. room-manager.ts: canStartGame counts presence with status ready AND connected (>=2). Delete client-messenger.ts and its test. src/test-mocks/room-session.ts: controllable fake of useRoomSession (setSession(partial), emitTransition(t), actions as vi.fn returning configurable AckResult) used via vi.mock('@/app/room/[id]/session/use-room-session'). Rewrite game-board.test.tsx and page.test.tsx to that fake, keeping the existing role/text assertions; update order tests to submitted -> game-ended (client R4.1) and timer tests to deadline/timeout-event semantics (no client pass sent).
Seams: T5's new props (Seat.connected, ConnectionOverlay.reason, GameSetDialog ready props) and T4's real hook are resolved at integration; use exactly the prop names in spec §9.4.
Acceptance: game-board, waiting-room, RoomHeader, notification, hooks (useMyField) and page tests pass with the fake; no imports of partysocket, client-messenger or @/interface/server-to-client in owned files; no client-side pass on timer expiry (test asserts actions.pass not called when the clock hits 0).

tasks.title: Entry, identity cookie, lobby counters and /room/new
tasks.instructions:
middleware.ts: keep matcher /room/:path* and the name gate but validate with isValidName from @/shared/name; when pd_sid cookie is missing or fails SID_RE, set it on the response (generateSid(), 365 days, SameSite=Lax, Secure when https, path /, not httpOnly), on both the pass-through and redirect responses. login/page.tsx: after setting the name cookie call getOrCreateSid() (src/lib/session-id.ts); keep the location.pathname = callback behaviour. realtime-http.ts: createRoom(): POST httpUrl('/rooms') with cache 'no-store' and AbortSignal.timeout(10000), validate response {roomId} matches ROOM_ID_RE, throw on failure; getRoomInfo(id). room/new/page.tsx: server component calling createRoom() then redirect(`/room/${roomId}`); error.tsx/loading.tsx untouched. use-lobby-stats.ts: hook opening WebSocket wsUrl('/lobby') with simple capped backoff (1..10s), parsing LobbyStats frames via @/shared/protocol, returning {online, lobby, rooms} or null before first data; silent on connection errors (no console.error) so screens.mjs stays clean; injectable WebSocket ctor for tests. page.tsx: replace usePartySocket with useLobbyStats; LobbyCounters shows '—' while null; random match/training placeholders unchanged.
Acceptance: tests cover middleware redirect with callback, sid issued when missing and kept when valid, invalid sid replaced; login sets sid; home shows '—' then counts from a fake socket frame (online = sum(room)+lobby, rooms = key count); /room/new redirects on success and throws on HTTP error/timeout (error boundary path); no partysocket imports in owned files.

tasks.title: Ops: CI, README, E2E suite, screenshot script filters, runbook
tasks.instructions:
CI per spec §12.4: test job (no secrets): npm ci, npx biome ci src worker e2e, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build (no NEXT_PUBLIC_PARTYKIT_HOST env; remove that secret reference), npm run build-storybook, npx wrangler deploy --dry-run -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --outdir dist-worker. Optional jobs `integration` and `e2e` on workflow_dispatch or PR label 'e2e' (npx playwright install --with-deps chromium; E2E=1 npm run test:e2e). E2E: e2e/playwright.config.ts skips entirely unless E2E=1; webServer starts `npm run dev:server -- --var GRACE_PLAYING_MS:5000 --var GRACE_IDLE_MS:5000 --var AWAY_TURN_CAP_MS:3000 --var ALLOWED_ORIGINS:http://localhost:3124` (verify wrangler --var syntax) and `next dev -p 3124` with NEXT_PUBLIC_REALTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787; fixtures.ts creates two browser contexts with name cookies alice/bob and helpers (joinRoom, readyAndStart, handCardIds, seatLayoutIds). Specs implement spec §12.2 scenarios 1-8 using role/text selectors (準備OK, ゲーム開始, パス, 退出, 別のタブで開かれています, このタブで再開, GAME SET dialog) and data attributes already present (seat layoutIds seat-<pid>); scenario timing via expect.poll, no fixed sleeps beyond the shortened grace. scripts/screens.mjs and flights.mjs: change the ignored WebSocket/connection error filter from :1999 to :8787 (also ignore failed lobby socket), keep exit-non-zero on other console errors. README: replace Getting Started, バックエンド and 6. デプロイメント with the new stack (npm run dev single command, dev:web/dev:server, env vars, test commands incl. INTEGRATION/E2E, deploy steps pointing to docs/realtime/runbook.md, Worker-first deploy order, partyserver as documented routing fallback, Workers Paid as escape hatch); keep the package-lock note. runbook.md: deploy (Workers Builds or npm run deploy:server, Vercel env), env matrix (dev/preview/prod), custom domain, usage notifications, rollback, smoke checklist (create room, two devices, reload mid-game, airplane mode 10s), manual phone checklist (iOS Safari background 2 min, Android tab discard).
